### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We see this as a turning point: faster answers, deeper understanding, and a new era of scientific progress.

2. We stand for accelerating discovery. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of science—helping us test ideas, connect disciplines, and push beyond today’s limits.

3. We have a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We must prepare now to turn that acceleration into benefits shared by everyone.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We regard that transformation as a defining opportunity for science and society. We will gain more than faster calculations: we will gain the ability to explore more hypotheses, connect knowledge across disciplines, and move promising ideas toward decisive tests. We must prepare our institutions for that acceleration, equipping researchers to use these systems responsibly and ensuring that new knowledge serves the public. We want scientific progress measured not only in papers published, but in problems solved. We are committed to turning a faster age of discovery into a better future for everyone.
